page.title: Position
page.purpose: Answer 'where do I stand' in one screen — runway, goal verdicts, and whether any figure is missing an input it needed.

priorities.statement: Runway and each goal verdict, with the sustain window's progress
Whether this position is partial, and which adapter is missing
Everything else, ranked below the three above

states.description: The surface at rest with data present — the state a journey step assumes when it names none.
Nothing in flight; the surface is at rest and its controls are usable.
A user-triggered operation is in flight and its outcome is not yet known.
An operation completed; the result is announced, not merely rendered.
First read of the surface's data; layout is reserved so nothing shifts on arrival.
A write is in flight; the affected control is disabled and says why.
A background read is refreshing data the user is already looking at.
A user-requested re-read of data already on screen.
The query succeeded and there is genuinely nothing — distinct from not-yet-loaded. No postings exist yet, so position is undefined rather than zero.
Some contributing source could not be read; what is missing is named.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown.
Input was rejected before submission; the offending field is identified.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated.
An automatic retry is in progress; attempt count and next attempt are visible.
The caller's role does not permit this; what role would is stated.
The client cannot reach the API; queued or read-only behavior is explained.
At least one contributing adapter is unavailable. The figure is shown with the gap named; it is never silently completed with a zero.
Every contributing adapter was available and fresh. The only state in which a figure stands without a caveat.
A declared goal's threshold is not currently satisfied; the gap and the sustain-window progress are both shown.
The selected window has journal observations and the runway-and-burn trend shows each series with its source and basis.
The selected window has no postings; the trend remains undefined and the table explains how to begin.
A contributing source is unavailable for part of the selected window; the trend shows an explicit gap and never fills it with zero.
The newest observation in the selected window is past its freshness window; the trend names its age.

elements.name: Runway
elements.description: Months of runway at current burn and revenue. The page's headline figure and the first thing read.
The basis of the runway figure — which inputs were authoritative, derived, or operator-asserted, and how old the oldest one is.

elements.name: Position is partial
elements.description: States that at least one contributing adapter could not be read, and names it. Present only when the position is partial.
The specific adapter that could not be read, its failure reason, and the age of its last success. Inline, not behind a drill-in.

elements.name: Goals
elements.description: Declared financial goals with a verdict each. A goal is a threshold plus a sustain window, so a verdict is never just met/unmet.
Progress through a goal's sustain window. A threshold met for one month out of three required is not the same as met.
Change in each headline figure since the previous reading, carrying direction as a sign and a word rather than a colour.
First-run guidance explaining that position is undefined until postings exist, and where to add the first one.
Assertive notice that the position request itself failed — distinct from a position that computed but is partial.

elements.name: Runway and burn trend
elements.description: A keyboard-readable trend of inflow, outflow, and net movement over the selected window.

elements.name: Runway and burn trend data
elements.description: Visible tabular equivalent of every plotted series, including an em dash for an unavailable interval.
Names the Money Ledger journal source and the basis of the trend observations.
Names the unavailable interval and explains that it is a gap rather than zero or an interpolation.

elements.name: Trend window
elements.description: Selects the number of days included in the trend.

claims.statement: When the position is partial, the adapter that could not be read is named on this page without opening another view.
claims.rationale: Priority 2 and OT-P1-004. 'Some data is missing' without naming the source forces the operator to guess which figure to distrust.

claims.statement: A partial position is perceivably different from a complete one, without relying on the figure's value.
claims.rationale: The scenario's signature guarantee. If the two states render identically, a silent zero is indistinguishable from a real one — the exact defect this product exists to refuse. The live UI binds completeness and missing-source text to the position response; the current route-only capture provider cannot change adapter availability between state captures.

claims.statement: With no postings at all, the page explains that position is undefined rather than displaying a zero runway.
claims.rationale: The same honesty rule at first-run. A zero runway on an empty ledger is a confidently wrong number and the most alarming possible first impression.

claims.statement: The runway figure is accompanied by the basis of its inputs and the age of the oldest one.
claims.rationale: PRD honesty rule and DESIGN.md: every figure has room beside it for its basis, so provenance is never hidden behind a hover.

claims.statement: Runway and the completeness of the position read before the goal list and any secondary figure.
claims.rationale: Priorities 1 and 2. Whether the number can be trusted must arrive with the number, not after it. Direction-aware so the order survives RTL.

claims.statement: A goal verdict is accompanied by its progress through the sustain window, not only whether the threshold is currently crossed.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-002. The source canon's default-alive rule requires three consecutive months; a verdict that ignores the window would report 'met' on the first good month and be wrong.

claims.statement: A failed position request is perceivably different from a position that computed but is missing a source.
claims.rationale: 'I could not compute this' and 'I computed this without one input' lead to different operator actions. Collapsing them wastes the distinction the whole ingest contract creates. The live UI uses an alert for request failure and a named completeness gap for partial data; the current route-only capture provider cannot create an API outage and a partial response in one matrix.

claims.statement: Runway and the position's completeness are visible without scrolling at every viewport.
claims.rationale: Priority 1. A caveat below the fold is a caveat that will not be read, and this one changes the meaning of the figure above it.

claims.statement: Every change and every outflow carries a sign or a word, so its direction survives without colour perception.
claims.rationale: DESIGN.md binding adaptation and the PRD accessibility rule. Manual because it is a perceptual property of a rendered value rather than an element-presence check.

claims.statement: Figures compared across rows use tabular numerals and share a decimal alignment.
claims.rationale: DESIGN.md binding adaptation: financial figures on this scenario's surfaces are read in comparison, which misaligned proportional digits actively defeat.

claims.statement: The runway-and-burn trend has a visible table equivalent in the same surface.
claims.rationale: A chart cannot be the only representation of financial values; the table carries exact values and unavailable gaps.

claims.statement: The trend names its Money Ledger source and observation basis beside the series.
claims.rationale: Operator-asserted and derived numbers must not be mistaken for authoritative telemetry.

claims.statement: When a source is unavailable, the trend and table show a named gap rather than zero or an interpolated value.
claims.rationale: Unknown financial observations are not false and never become a passing zero.

claims.statement: The operator can choose the trend window from a labeled control.
claims.rationale: The trend is a decision surface, so its time horizon must be inspectable rather than fixed in code.
